name: in_code_section
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Indiana Code — Indiana state law — by citation, plus when it was added or amended. "IC 9-21-5-5" is an oversized-vehicle speed limit (traffic, Title 9); "IC 32-31-3-6" defines "rent" in the landlord-tenant chapter (Title 32). An ARTICLE ("IC 24-16") or CHAPTER ("IC 24-16-4") reference also works — it returns that group's own section list (citation + heading for each) instead of failing, so you can pick the right one and call this again for its full text. Pass `year` (e.g. 2020) to retrieve a historical annual edition instead of the current code — Indiana publishes a separate archived edition per year. Keyless. Use for "what does Indiana Code 9-21-5-5 say" or to check an Indiana statute a lease, ticket, or case relies on.

section.description: Section, chapter, or article as cited — "9-21-5-5" (section), "24-16-4" (chapter), "24-16" (article). The title is the part before the first dash (title "7.1" is the one exception that itself contains a dot).

year.description: Optional 4-digit year for a historical annual edition, e.g. "2020". Omit for the current Indiana Code.

name: in_code_search
description: Search the Indiana Code BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "traffic oversized vehicle permit", "landlord retaliatory eviction", "concealed handgun license". Returns ranked sections with their citations across all 37 Indiana Code titles; use in_code_section afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord retaliatory eviction".
